title: SOEP Variable Finder: multilingual semantic search over SOEP-Core variable metadata
description: Semantic discovery of SOEP-Core survey-variable metadata: plain-language search in German and English over the official SOEP-Core v41 structural metadata (paneldata.org), covering 125,496 variables with bilingual labels, the official concept and topic hierarchy, the survey question wording and response scales. Retrieval uses a multilingual e5 bi-encoder with a cross-encoder reranker. Metadata only; no microdata is included or served.
